heading: Government of Naval Asylum
lead: The asylum for disabled and decrepit Navy officers, seamen, and marines shall be governed in accordance with the rules and regulations prescribed by the Secretary of the Navy.

notes.heading: Codification
notes.text: R.S. § 4811 derived from act Feb. 26, 1811, ch. 26, § 4, 2 Stat. 650.
